Helper functions
```{r}
# ID UP, DOWN, NO CHANGE GENES

gen_gene_lists <- function(results) {
  up <- filter(results, padj < 0.1 & log2FoldChange > 0)
  down <- filter(results, padj < 0.1 & log2FoldChange < 0)
  no_change <- filter(results, padj >= 0.1)
  return(list(up = up$X, down = down$X, no_change = no_change$X)) 
}



# LABEL GENES BY STATUS, EXTRACT CODON USAGE INFO

filter_genes <- function(data, genes) {
  filtered <- data %>%
    filter(gene %in% c(genes$up, genes$down, genes$no_change)) %>%
    mutate(Set = case_when(
      gene %in% genes$up ~ "Up",
      gene %in% genes$down ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NoChange"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Down", "NoChange", "Up")))
  
  annotations <- data.frame(Set = filtered %>% distinct(gene, Set) %>% pull(Set))
  rownames(annotations) <- rownames(filtered)

  return(list(results = filtered, sets = annotations))
}

violinPlot <- function(data, wilcox) {
  
  longData <- data$results %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(GC1, GC2, GC3), names_to = "GC_type", values_to = "GC_value")
  # 1) Get max y per facet for bracket placement
  max_y <- longData %>%
    group_by(GC_type) %>%
    summarise(y_max = max(GC_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # 2) Data frame for stat_pvalue_manual
  pvals_for_plot <- wilcox %>%
    left_join(max_y, by = "GC_type") %>%
    group_by(GC_type) %>%
    mutate(
      p = p.value,
      y.position = y_max + 0.02 + 0.03 * row_number()
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # 3) Violin plot
  violin <- ggplot(longData, aes(x = Set, y = GC_value, fill = Set)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
    labs(
      x = "Expression Category",
      y = "GC Fraction"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ GC_type) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 4) Add p-values
  violinP <- violin +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      pvals_for_plot,
      label = "p",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      step.increase = 0,
      size = 2
    )

  violinP
}


getWilcox <- function(data) {
  
  data_long <- data$results %>%
  
  pivot_longer(cols = c(GC1, GC2, GC3), names_to = "GC_type", values_to = "GC_value")
    
  data_long$Set <- factor(data_long$Set, levels = c("NoChange", "Up", "Down"))
  
  wilcoxon <- data_long %>%
  group_by(GC_type) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    pw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
      x = .x$GC_value,
      g = .x$Set,
      p.adjust.method = "BH",
      paired = FALSE,
      exact = FALSE
    )
    broom::tidy(pw)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
  
  return(wilcoxon)
  
}

sig_codons <- function(data){
  freq_long <- data$results %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene,
                 names_to = "codon",
                 values_to = "frequency")
  
  annot <- data$sets %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="gene")
  
  freq_annot <- freq_long %>%
    left_join(
      annot, by="gene"
    )
  
  freq_results <- freq_annot %>%
    group_by(codon,Set) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_freq = mean(frequency, na.rm=TRUE),
      se_freq = sd(frequency, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  codon_stats <- freq_annot %>%
    group_by(codon) %>%
    summarise(
      p_value = kruskal.test(frequency ~ Set)$p.value,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  codon_stats <- codon_stats %>%
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"))
  
  freq_results <- left_join(freq_results, codon_stats, by = "codon")
  
  freq_results <- freq_results %>%
    mutate(
      GC_percent = str_count(codon, "[GCgc]") / 3 * 100
    )
  
  df_wide <- freq_results %>%
    dplyr::select(codon, Set, mean_freq, se_freq) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = Set,
      values_from = c(mean_freq, se_freq)
    ) 
  
  df_wide <- df_wide %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      up_mean       = mean_freq_Up,
      down_mean     = mean_freq_Down,
      nochange_mean = mean_freq_NoChange,
      up_se         = se_freq_Up,
      down_se       = se_freq_Down,
      nochange_se   = se_freq_NoChange
    )
  
  # 2. make a codon→GC lookup (one row per codon)
  gc_lookup <- freq_results %>%
    dplyr::select(codon, GC_percent) %>%
    distinct()
  
  pvalue_lookup <- freq_results %>%
    dplyr::select(codon,padj) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # 3. join it on
  df_wide2 <- df_wide %>%
    left_join(gc_lookup, by = "codon")
  
  df_wide3 <- df_wide2 %>%
    left_join(pvalue_lookup, by = "codon")
  
  return(list(res_long=freq_results,
              res_wide=df_wide3))
  
}
```

Run:
TSL
```{r}
tsl_lists <- gen_gene_lists(tsl_results)
tsl_codon_results <- filter_genes(usage, tsl_lists)
wcxTsl<-getWilcox(tsl_codon_results)
tsl_vio<-violinPlot(tsl_codon_results, wcxTsl)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir,"GC_Per_Position_TSL.pdf"),
  plot= tsl_vio,
  width = 6,
  height = 3,
  units = "in"
)

rna_lists <- gen_gene_lists(rna_results)
rna_codon_results <- filter_genes(usage, rna_lists)
wcxTslRNA<-getWilcox(rna_codon_results)
rna_vio<-violinPlot(rna_codon_results, wcxTslRNA)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir,"GC_Per_Position_RNA.pdf"),
  plot= rna_vio,
  width = 6,
  height = 3,
  units = "in"
)
```
